questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All tablets are laptops.

No laptop is a desktop.

No laptop is a mobile.

Conclusions:

(I) No tablet is a desktop.

(II) Some mobiles are desktops.
questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e6087d95331b768aec4e347389d6d8590a9fdbb837c90a853be2b36e24d14f3.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) No tablet is a desktop - **True**(because, all tablets are laptops and no laptops are desktops)

(II) Some mobiles are desktops - **False**(because, there is no direct relation is given between them, so it can be possible only).

Thus, Only conclusion (I) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4".**

questions.question: 38 people are standing in a row facing north. Hari is 11th from the right end while Hema is 14th from the left end. How many people are there between Hari and Hema?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Position of Hari from the right = 11

Position of Hari from the left = 38 - 11 + 1 = 28th

Position of Hema from the left = 14th

Now, the number of people between Hari and Hema is:

= Position of Hari from the left - Position of Hema from the left - 1

= 28 - 14 - 1

= 13.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(7, 80, 22)

(43, 143, 19)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: ** (First Number + Third Number) × 3 - First Number = Second Number.**

Let's verify this logic with the given sets:

For, (7, 80, 22)

⇒ (7 + 22) × 3 - 7 = 29 × 3 - 7 = 87 - 7 = 80.

Here, the logic followed.

For, (43, 143, 19)

⇒ (43 + 19) × 3 - 43 = 62 × 3 - 43 = 186 - 43 = 143.

Here, the logic followed.

Now, let's check the options based on this logic:

**Option 1) (11, 63, 15)**

⇒ (11 + 15) × 3 - 11 = 26 × 3 - 11 = 78 - 11 = 67. (Given Second number is 63, 63 ≠ 67)

Here, logic not followed.

**Option 2) (13, 89, 21)**

⇒ (13 + 21) × 3 - 13 = 34 × 3 - 13 = 102 - 13 = 89. (Matches)

**Here, logic followed.**

**Option 3) (25, 91, 15)**

⇒ (25 + 15) × 3 - 25 = 40 × 3 - 25 = 120 - 25 = 95. (Given Second number is 91, 91 ≠ 95)

Here, logic not followed.

**Option 4) (49, 139, 15)**

⇒ (49 + 15) × 3 - 49 = 64 × 3 - 49 = 192 - 49 = 143. (Given Second number is 139, 139 ≠ 143)

Here, logic not followed.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

What will be the resultant if the second digit of the highest number is subtracted from the third digit of the lowest number?
questions.solution:
Given: (Left) 815 497 460 637 147 (Right)

According to the question:

 
 

 Given numbers
 815
 497
 460
 637
 147
 
 

 Number are arranged in ascending order
 147
 460
 497
 637
 815
 
 

So,

Second digit of the highest number → 8__**1**__5 → 1

Third digit of the lowest number → 14__**7**__ → 7

Thus, if the second digit of the highest number is subtracted from the third digit of the lowest number then the resultant will be → 7 - 1 → **6** 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
